name.en-US: Morals on the Book of Job
name.pt-BR: Morais sobre o Livro de Jó

description.la: Expositio in librum beati Iob, triginta quinque libris, quam Gregorius Constantinopoli inchoavit et Romae perfecit; cum epistola ad Leandrum Hispalensem et praefatione.
description.en-US: Gregory's vast commentary on the Book of Job in thirty-five books, begun at Constantinople for his monastic companions and finished in Rome (c. 578-595): each verse is read historically, then allegorically, then morally. With the letter to Leander of Seville and the preface. Latin text of the Maurist edition (Migne, PL 75-76); English from the Oxford Library of the Fathers (1844-50), as transcribed on Lectionary Central.
description.pt-BR: O imenso comentário de Gregório ao Livro de Jó em trinta e cinco livros, começado em Constantinopla para os seus companheiros monges e concluído em Roma (c. 578-595): cada versículo é lido no sentido histórico, depois alegórico, depois moral. Com a carta a Leandro de Sevilha e o prefácio. Texto latino da edição beneditina (Migne, PL 75-76); inglês da Library of the Fathers de Oxford (1844-50).

la.editor: Maurist edition (Sainte-Marthe, 1705), as reprinted in Migne, PL 75-76 (1849)

en-US.translator: Library of the Fathers (Oxford: Parker, 1844-50), preface by Charles Marriott

sources.edition: Moralia, Epistola, Praefatio and Pars I-VI (Books I-XXXV) on Latin Wikisource (from the Corpus Corporum TEI of PL 75-76), with the Maurist chapter divisions (Caput) kept as headings.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; the inline PL page counter and the Maurist [Vet./Rec.] chapter cross-references stripped; sections numbered 1., 2. ... set as paragraphs. Raw text in sources/la-originals.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 6th-century work in the 1705 Maurist edition (Migne 1849): public domain.

sources.edition: Morals on the Book of Job by S. Gregory the Great (Library of the Fathers, 3 vols in 4, Oxford: Parker; London: Rivington, 1844-50), transcribed by Lectionary Central; the Epistle, Preface and Books I-XXXV. The transcriber's footnotes are only partly added (the Epistle has them).
sources.description: Navigation removed; the translator's chapter numbers [ii]... set as Chapter headings; summaries italicised; Scripture references kept inline.
